content.title: Boeing offers remedies in bid for EU approval for Spirit deal
content.summary: BRUSSELS (Reuters) -Boeing has offered remedies in a bid to secure EU approval to buy back Spirit AeroSystems, the world's largest standalone aerostructures company, according to an update on the European Commission website.  Boeing announced the $4.7 billion acquisition in July last year in a deal that would also see Airbus take on the supplier's loss-making Europe-focused activities.  The Commission, which acts as the EU competition enforcer, did not provide details on the remedies in line with its policy and extended its decision deadline for the deal to October 14.
